policy.what_happened: Proposed regulations would define the refunded portion of certain refundable Federal income tax credits as a "Federal public benefit."
policy.effect: If you are an alien who is not a "qualified alien", you would be ineligible to receive the refunded portion of certain refundable Federal income tax credits.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

tech.summary: Researchers reportedly used the AI model Claude to gain unauthorized access to an OpenAI employee account and sensitive GitHub data.
California Governor Gavin Newsom issued an executive order aimed at regulating artificial intelligence, citing concerns about its potential impact.
New satellite and machine learning technology is being developed to provide earlier warnings for flash floods, which can strike without prior notice.

world.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that Russian hybrid attacks against Europe are intensifying and has tasked his government with protecting critical infrastructure and defense industry sites.
A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed a mosque in Pakistan, resulting in the deaths of at least 17 people, including a four-year-old child, with gunmen also opening fire on a police facility.
European governments are discussing the imposition of a bloc-wide windfall tax on energy companies, as near-record fuel and gas prices are causing public discontent.

Widespread flight disruptions for hundreds of thousands of travelers in the UK were attributed to a software defect in the country's air traffic control system that corrupted flight data in a millisecond.

us.summary: An SUV driver was charged with murder after allegedly driving under the influence of drugs, swerving into the wrong lane, running a red light, and colliding with a Los Angeles city bus, resulting in the deaths of two passengers.
The White House announced the withdrawal of Lance Schroyer's nomination to lead ICE, ensuring the agency remains without a Senate-confirmed leader for an extended period.
A new report indicates that Federal Reserve staff missed critical signs of vulnerability at Silicon Valley Bank before its failure in 2023.

science.summary: A life-extending drug, Enhertu, is now available on the NHS in England for patients with incurable breast cancer, potentially offering an average of seven additional months of life.
Gene-editing technology is being explored to develop rootstock that could protect Florida's citrus trees from a bacterial infection that is currently devastating the industry.
